name: portfolio-widget

scripts.watch: mkdir -p dist && conc 'npm run css-watch' 'esbuild src/portfolio.tsx --bundle --outfile=dist/bundle.js --loader:.tsx=tsx --loader:.ts=tsx --minify --conditions=style --watch'
